phone.changelog: v2.9.4: Add a visible Bluetooth tethering button in Device. One tap opens Android tethering controls where supported, with network/settings fallbacks. Turn on the Android switch to enable sharing. Watch 2.9.3 remains compatible.

watch.changelog: v2.9.3: Add Internet from phone setup, live verified Bluetooth internet status, and Bluetooth/Wi-Fi settings shortcuts. Enable Android Bluetooth tethering and paired-phone Internet access on supported firmware.
